title: Week 51: Pets 🐶
content:
Week 51: Pets 🐶

This week I was mostly on pet duty for my friend’s dog and cat.
Not gonna lie, it’s not the easiest job 😅.

lucky

Morning & night dog walks 🚶‍♂️🐕

A cat that’s super alive at night 🌙🐈 (he even knows how to open doors!)

Result: me = barely any good sleep 😴

But hey, they’re just being animals, can’t really blame them ❤️.

On the brighter side, I also watched an animation called Secret Level 🎬🎮.
It’s a series inspired by game ideas. I went through the first 10 episodes — and honestly, pretty good stuff! 👍✨
